bibl.title: A Fragment of a Biblical Cento in the Duke Papyrus Archive (P.Duk. inv. 660)
bibl.seg: Nicholas E. Wagner, A Fragment of a Biblical Cento in the Duke Papyrus Archive (P.Duk. inv. 660)
bibl.note: P.Duke inv. 660, a papyrus fragment containing on both sides a mixture or patchwork (i.e. a cento) of citations of and allusions to the Greek bible, including Gen 27:28, Pss 26:2, 4, 41:2, 123:7, and 2 Cor 6:2. It might fit under the umbrella of Lieblingstexte (favorite texts). Third or fourth century.
